facts.fact: Former Births and Deaths Registrar Henrietta Lamptey and Yvonne Boatemaa-Yeboah write that since 2017 the government has worked to link the Births and Deaths Registry with the NIA's systems, with the birth-to-NIA transfer described as envisioned.
Henrietta Lamptey and Yvonne Boatemaa-Yeboah write that the Births and Deaths Registry is transitioning from manual, paper-based records to a digital platform.

facts.fact: Henrietta Lamptey and Yvonne Boatemaa-Yeboah write that the Ghana Card is a biometric national identification card issued by the National Identification Authority and mandatory for accessing a wide range of services.
The Ghana Card is mandatory for banking, SIM card registration, social welfare programmes and voting, per Henrietta Lamptey and Yvonne Boatemaa-Yeboah.
